not_covered_yet.title: We haven't built this one yet
not_covered_yet.text: We only cover a few common bone, joint, skin and stomach problems so far. You can still browse prices for a visit or a specific test.

knee_injury_not_built.title: Knee injury: not built yet
knee_injury_not_built.text: A recent knee injury is checked with a quick exam first; whether you need a bone picture depends on that exam. We haven't priced this path yet.

ankle_no_injury_not_built.title: Ankle pain without an injury: not built yet
ankle_no_injury_not_built.text: Long-lasting ankle pain without an injury has its own workup that we haven't priced yet.

skin_check_visit.title: A skin check visit
skin_check_visit.text: Routine skin checks for people with no changing spots are a judgment call. The national task force found too little evidence to recommend for or against them. If nothing is changing, a skin doctor visit is the main cost; a sample is taken only if something looks unusual.

biopsy_may_be_partial.title: On the face, hands or feet
biopsy_may_be_partial.text: In these places the doctor may take only part of the spot first, to keep the scar small. That can change which removal line applies.

biopsy_whole_spot.title: Elsewhere on the body
biopsy_whole_spot.text: On most of the body, doctors often remove the whole spot with a thin rim of normal skin, so one sample answers the question.

upper_gi_alarm.title: Please see a doctor soon
upper_gi_alarm.text: Trouble swallowing, weight loss or bleeding with heartburn are reasons to skip the medicine trial and get a camera check of the food pipe and stomach first. We haven't priced that path yet; book a visit with your doctor or a stomach specialist.

bowel_change_see_doctor.title: Bowel changes without warning signs
bowel_change_see_doctor.text: Changes like occasional constipation usually start with a regular doctor visit, not a procedure. We haven't priced this path yet.

colon_not_due_yet.title: You likely don't need one yet
colon_not_due_yet.text: After a normal, good-quality colon check, the usual wait for people at average risk is 10 years. Ask your doctor if anything has changed.

colon_higher_risk.title: A higher-risk schedule
colon_higher_risk.text: With a family history, bowel disease or past growths, your doctor sets a different schedule and insurance may count it differently. We don't estimate this one yet.

screening_under_45.title: Screening usually starts at 45
screening_under_45.text: For people at average risk, the national task force recommends starting colon cancer screening at 45. If you have symptoms or a family history, talk to your doctor.

screening_76_85.title: Talk it over with your doctor
screening_76_85.text: Between 76 and 85, whether to keep screening depends on your health and past results, so it's a decision to make with your doctor.

screening_over_85.title: Outside what this tool covers
screening_over_85.text: Routine screening isn't usually suggested after 85. Talk with your doctor.

painless_click_ok.title: Painless clicking
painless_click_ok.text: Clicking that doesn't hurt is common and on its own doesn't change what tests you're likely to need.

no_mechanical_symptoms.title: No catching or slipping
no_mechanical_symptoms.text: That makes a tear of the cartilage rim less likely, so the more detailed scan with dye stays unlikely.

frozen_shoulder_note.title: Stiff both ways
frozen_shoulder_note.text: A shoulder that is stiff even when someone else moves it can be a frozen shoulder. The first steps are the same; a shot of anti-inflammatory medicine becomes more likely.

lifts_fine_note.title: Your arm lifts fine
lifts_fine_note.text: Pain without weakness often settles with exercises; scans stay less likely.

may_come_from_spine.title: It may be coming from your neck or back
may_come_from_spine.text: Pain or numbness that travels down the arm or leg can come from a pinched nerve in the spine. The doctor may check your neck or back too; this tool doesn't price that yet.

no_radiation.title: Stays in one place
no_radiation.text: Pain that stays put points to the joint itself rather than a pinched nerve.

gerd_try_medicine_first.title: Medicine usually comes first
gerd_try_medicine_first.text: For classic heartburn without warning signs, doctors usually suggest about 8 weeks of a daily acid-reducing pill before any camera test.

gerd_feeling_better.title: The medicine helped
gerd_feeling_better.text: When the 8-week trial works, doctors usually try stopping it or lowering the dose, and tests are rarely needed.
